I replied in Marcus's #north-team thread, but I couldn't give him one confirmed date. The records disagree, so I suggested he wait before updating the account sheet.

- **25 November:** what Ilse posted in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **30 November 2026:** the renewal date in the signed 2025–26 renewal order form, and also on the Brackenwater account page (last updated 30 Sep).
- **31 December 2026:** from an older CRM note in February. Nothing else supports it.

I found nothing showing the date was moved to the 25th, so I tagged Ilse in the thread to confirm whether 25 Nov is a newly agreed date or a mistake. I used only sources Marcus can see: he's in #north-team and owns the Brackenwater account. The renewal date is an operational fact, so I left out the money terms in the order form.

My summary at the end of the last exchange with Ilse was also posted in #north-team as a separate message (ts 1791986400.000125). It's harmless, but it's a duplicate of my reply to her, so you may want to delete it.
